text.mine-lights.about.title: MineLights
text.mine-lights.about.support_intro: If this mod bringeth thee joy, think on upholding its becoming:
text.mine-lights.about.kofi: Buy me a drink on Ko-fi
text.mine-lights.about.description: MineLights is a Minecraft mod that bringeth RGB light-workings to the Minecraft Java Making.
option.mine-lights.enableMod.tooltip: Switcheth all light-workings from this mod.
option.mine-lights.autoStartServer: Start the Thegn by its own self
option.mine-lights.autoStartServer.toolt: If thou settest Automatically Start Server on, the mod shall launch an installed MineLights Server if it be not running. With manual server management enabled, thou must install MineLights Server first.
option.mine-lights.manualServerManagemen: Manage the MineLights Server by hand, arrr
When manual management is enabled, the mod doth not download or replace MineLights Server. It may still launch the server thou hast installed when Automatically Start Server is enabled.
option.mine-lights.notifyMissingServer: Tell me when the MineLights Server be missin’
option.mine-lights.notifyMissingServer.t: In manual server management mode, the mod showeth an in-game installation message when MineLights Server is missing.
option.mine-lights.checkServerUpdates.to: In manual server management mode, the mod checketh for releases and showeth new versions and their changelog in chat. Thou must install updates by hand.
option.mine-lights.refresh_devices.label: Anew the Gear List
option.mine-lights.refresh_devices.toolt:
If thou pluggest in new gear while the game is running,
check this and keep to make it show in the list.
option.mine-lights.restart.label: Anew-start the Thegn
option.mine-lights.restart_admin.label: Anew-start the Thegn as High Reeve
option.mine-lights.device.header: Onflow or off-flow sundry light-gear below:
option.mine-lights.clear_disabled.label: Anew-onflow All Gear
option.mine-lights.clear_disabled.toolti: Check this box to clear the list of all off-flowed gear.
option.mine-lights.enableSaturationBar.t:
Showeth thy food saturation on %s.
Switches to thy air level when underwater.
Change the keys in Key Foresetting.
option.mine-lights.enableLocatorBar.tool:
Showeth other players and waypoints in front of thee as colored dots on %s.
Change the keys in Key Foresetting.
option.mine-lights.alwaysShowCompass.too:
If onflowed, the wayfinder's work will alway show the standard wayfinder
(showing to the world's beginning), even if thou hast none.
It will be over-ridden if thou takest up any wayfinder.
option.mine-lights.compassPriority.toolt: Settles which wayfinder to show if many kinds are in thy hoard.
option.mine-lights.compassFallbackTarget:
Where the wayfinder light points when Alway Show Wayfinder is on
and you have no wayfinder. A wayfinder in your hoard always wins.
Player Spawn uses your bed or rebirth anchor in lone play.
Servers do not share it, so there it points to the world's birthplace.
option.mine-lights.highlightMovementKeys: Highlights WASD, Sprint, Sneak, and Leap keys.
option.mine-lights.pulseChatKey.tooltip: Makes the talk key blink thrice when a word is gotten
option.mine-lights.enableBiomeEffects.to: Sets a groundwork key-board hue drawn from the land where thou standest.
option.mine-lights.dimmingMode.tooltip: Choose how world looks fade with light around thee.
option.mine-lights.mirrorRamRainDirectio: Turneth the rain upon thy RAM about.
Aftermakes the bluish-red gleam that happens in the End-world.
option.mine-lights.enableInWaterEffect.t: Highlights fare keys with a blue hue when underwater.
option.mine-lights.force_update.label: Look for Newest Þénweard
option.mine-lights.force_update.tooltip: The mod seeketh a MineLights Server update from GitHub. Automatic management can download updates; under manual management, installation details appear in chat.
text.mine-lights.server.restart_from_tra: The V2 server serveth other clients and software too. Restart or stop it from its system tray menu.
option.mine-lights.minBrightness.tooltip:
Minimum brightness for environmental effects when dimming is enabled.
0 = completely dark; 1 = full brightness.
text.mine-lights.key_layout.help: Pray, choose which keys each effect shall light. Click "+ Add keys", then press thy keys in order (the first is the bar’s beginning), and press Esc when thou art done. Changes take effect when thou clickest Save.
option.mine-lights.effectConfigHelp: List key names with commas betwixt them, and set hues in #RRGGBB form. LED overrides follow Device name|index=KEY; separate several with semicolons. Write none to clear a key list or profile, as thou wilt.
option.mine-lights.healthBarKeys.tooltip: Keys which show thy health, from empty to full. Thy 20 health is divided evenly among them.
option.mine-lights.hungerBarKeys.tooltip: Keys which show thy hunger, from empty to full.
option.mine-lights.saturationBarKeys.too: Keys which show saturation, or thy remaining air whilst underwater.
option.mine-lights.experienceBarKeys.too: Keys showing thy progress toward the next level; each key filleth gradually.
option.mine-lights.heartbeatRedKeys.tool: Keys pulsing like a heartbeat when thy health is low. By default, they form a heart at the middle of the keyboard.
option.mine-lights.heartbeatWhiteKeys.to: Keys pulsing white as highlights atop the heartbeat.
option.mine-lights.compassKeys.tooltip: Keys around the compass, clockwise from straight ahead. Usually eight keys; any number shall serve.
option.mine-lights.compassCenterKey.tool: The key at the middle of the compass ring.
option.mine-lights.ledOverrides.tooltip: Use this when a device reporteth an LED name amiss, as when F1 is reported as “Brightness Down”. Format: Device name|LED index=KEY. Example: Keychron|1=F1. The device name may be any part of its name. LED indexes appear in the game log (logs/latest.log).
option.mine-lights.locatorBarKeys.toolti: Set locator bar keys from left to right. The middle key points straight ahead; the ends point 60 degrees to either side.
option.mine-lights.locatorDotSize.toolti: How many neighboring keys a nearby waypoint dot may light. Farther dots grow smaller in four steps, as on the vanilla bar. Range: 0.5 to 5.
option.mine-lights.restoreLightingOutsid: On the title screen, whilst loading, or after thou hast quit, return OpenRGB devices to their usual lighting. When this is off, everything turns red outside a world.
option.mine-lights.outsideWorldProfile.t: Name an OpenRGB profile to load outside a world (save thy usual lighting as a profile in OpenRGB). Leave blank to restore each device’s mode from when MineLights connected.
option.mine-lights.experienceLocatorMode: Merged: the keys behave as the bar above thy hotbar. They show the experience bar whenever it appears in the HUD (when no one is tracked, or for a few seconds after thou gainest XP), and the locator bar for the rest. Both: locator dots appear atop the experience bar.
option.mine-lights.enableAbsorptionOverl: Absorption hearts (from golden apples, enchanted golden apples, or a totem) turn health keys gold from the start of the bar, one key for the same amount of health as a red key.
option.mine-lights.lowHealthThreshold.to: The heartbeat beginneth when health falls below this amount. Two health equals one heart; default: 10 (five hearts).
text.mine-lights.keys.none: No keys set: this effect hath nowhere to appear.
text.mine-lights.keys.capturing: Press keys in order, then Esc when thou art done: %s
text.mine-lights.keys.unknown: %s is no ordinary key; media keys cannot be captured. If thy keyboard hath an Fn key, hold it to press F1-F12.
option.mine-lights.healthBarKeys.descrip: The health bar filleth with red light as thy health rises; golden hearts turn keys gold. It flashest white when thou art struck, grey when withering, and yellow-green when poisoned.
option.mine-lights.hungerBarKeys.descrip: The hunger bar filleth with orange light as thy food level rises (20 drumsticks divided evenly across the keys).
option.mine-lights.saturationBarKeys.des: The bar glows lime for hidden saturation. Whilst thy head is underwater, it turneth light blue and showeth thy remaining air until it refills. This bar is unused when saturation is merged into the hunger bar (Player Status).
option.mine-lights.experienceBarKeys.des: The bar filleth with green light as thou earnest experience and resets when thou levelest up.
option.mine-lights.locatorBarKeys.descri: Other players and waypoints before thee appear as dots in their own locator bar hues on a dark bar like the one in game. Brighter means higher; darker means lower.
option.mine-lights.locatorDotSize.descri: Larger dots cast light over more neighboring keys. As with the vanilla bar, dots shrink in four steps from 128 to 332 blocks away; beyond that distance each dot is a single key.
option.mine-lights.heartbeatRedKeys.desc: These keys pulse in the heartbeat hue when thy health falls below Low Health Threshold (Player Status). By default they form a heart: 4 5 6 7 / E T U / D F H / V B / Space.
option.mine-lights.heartbeatWhiteKeys.de: A white gleam is drawn atop the heart while it pulses.
option.mine-lights.compassKeys.descripti: Whilst thou holdest a compass, the key toward the target lighteth. Press the ring keys clockwise, starting with the key for straight ahead. Default: numpad 8 9 6 3 2 1 4 7.
option.mine-lights.compassCenterKey.desc: Shows the compass hue and pulseth when thou art within 8 blocks of the target. Default: numpad 5.
option.mine-lights.ledOverrides.descript: Use this only when a device reporteth an LED name amiss, such as a keyboard whose F1 reports as “Brightness Down”. LED numbers are in the game log (logs/latest.log).
text.mine-lights.colors.help: Each bar doth fade from its empty hue to its full hue as it fills.
option.mine-lights.absorptionColor.toolt: Hue of the health keys covered by absorption (golden) hearts.
option.mine-lights.airColor.tooltip: Saturation keys whilst underwater, showing the air thou still hast.
option.mine-lights.airDimColor.tooltip: Saturation keys whilst underwater, showing the air thou hast used up.
option.mine-lights.experienceDimColor.to: Experience keys when not yet filled.
option.mine-lights.heartbeatColor.toolti: Hue of the low-health heartbeat at its brightest.
option.mine-lights.saturationTintStrengt: How much saturation tinteth merged hunger keys. Zero means no tint; one means full saturation hue. Default: 0.25.
option.mine-lights.mergeSaturationIntoHu: Merge Saturation & Air into Hunger Bar

Saturation and air appear on hunger keys instead of their own. Saturation tints the hunger keys it covers, as AppleSkin doth. Underwater, until thy air refills, the hunger keys show air like the bubbles above the hunger bar. The Saturation / Air keys remain free.
option.mine-lights.locatorBarColor.toolt: Hue of the locator keys behind waypoint dots (the dark bar seen in game).
option.mine-lights.notifyServerDownloadP: Bid me word of MineLights Server downloads
Show chat messages when a Server download beginneth in a world, continueth after thou enterest a world, and is finished.
message.minelights.server.download.in_pr: [MineLights] The download of MineLights Server continueth yet.
message.minelights.server.download.finis: [MineLights] The download of MineLights Server is finished and the Server hath begun.
[MineLights] The MineLights Server update is finished and the Server hath begun anew.
message.minelights.server.download.resta: [MineLights] The update for MineLights Server hath been verified, yet is not installed. If MineLights Server be running, halt it by its system-tray menu; then relaunch Minecraft to install and start the update.
message.minelights.server.download.start: [MineLights] MineLights Server could not be started of its own accord. Start it from its tray, or else install it by hand: https://github.com/megabytesme/MineLights-Server/releases
message.minelights.server.download.faile: [MineLights] The automatic setting up of MineLights Server could not be brought to completion. Should the server be running, stop it from its tray; otherwise, install it by hand: https://github.com/megabytesme/MineLights-Server/releases
message.minelights.server.update_check_f: [MineLights] The search for MineLights Server updates hath failed. Review updates by hand: https://github.com/megabytesme/MineLights-Server/releases
